notes.title: Update 3 - EVEN MORE HOTFIXES
notes.notes:
Whats New?
-Improvments to AI
-Small Bug Fixes
-Crashing issue for some users fixed
-Final Level Ending Fixed
-Added new music to ending
-Doors at the last level are now locked and will require a key to open

Keep the bug reports coming!

notes.title: Update 1 - Day 1 hot fixes
notes.notes:
Hey guys thanks to everyone who reported bugs! I was able to get most of them with this update and I will fix more tomorrow.

If you run into any issues please let me know as soon as possible!

Whats new?
-Buffed Shotgun
-Buffed Semi Auto Rifle
-Buffed 1911 Pistol
-Buffed tommy gun
-Headshots are now detectable
-Fixed AI in "Amico Nostra"
-Fixed UI issues
-Added new stuff to the tutorial
-Added new entrances

notes.title: RELEASE DAY!!!
notes.notes:
Thanks to all of you Cosa Nostra is now avaliable! 

The "Contracts" mode will be released in early December, I'm not releasing it now just so, if anyone has suggestions for contracts they can let me know and I can have them in the game once the game mode releases. So please if you have any contract ideas let me know.

To anyone who bought the game today if you run into any bugs or problems or just have suggestions please let me know so I can address them as soon as possible!

Have fun everyone!

notes.title: Release Tomorrow!
notes.notes:
Thanks to all the beta testers helping me tackle bugs Cosa Nostra will be realeased Tomorrow Morning! The game will be listed at $9.99 however will have a 40% launch discount so you can pick it up for only $5.99!
A new game mode is also being worked on called contracts. Basically just missions sererate from the story line. These will come out early in December so if you have any suggestions leave them below or on the fourms!  Bugs may also be prevelant since it is launch day so if you spot any please let me know either through twitter or through the fourms and I will try to get a hot fix out as soon as possible! 

Have fun everyone!

If you have any suggestions or anything to report please do so I can get it into the game ASAP!

Twitter: https://twitter.com/NickRizzoGames
